span.p: row committed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /basic/forgot_password
code created ONLY if the email exists,
response body identical either way (SEC-017)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /basic/forgot_verify with email + code
validate_password, set_password,
then DELETE every code for that account

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: code expired — row deleted, 400 returned

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PATCH /member/admin/switch_active
PATCH /member/admin/switch_paid (also flips member.is_paid)
PATCH /basic/private/toggle-active

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: same toggle endpoints, re-run

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DELETE /member/admin/delete or /basic/private/delete
deleting Private_private cascades to member_member,
company, recruit, notice, reset codes

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /basic/register — AllowAny, throttle 10/hour
MemberSerializer.create, caller-supplied password
private_input whitelist = {email} only

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /member/admin/newUser_email — IsAdminUser
create_user or create_superuser
8-char random password, never returned

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /member/Add_byExcel_checked/ — IsAdminUser
preview then confirm, per-row savepoint
12-char random password

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CustomUserManager.create_user
email lower-cased and unique, set_password hash
is_active=True, is_staff=False, is_superuser=False
spawns threading.Thread welcome mail (no plaintext password since MED-5)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Active

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /basic/login
authenticate() then RefreshToken.for_user
Set-Cookie access_token HttpOnly, 3h

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /basic/logout — delete_cookie
or access token expires

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GET /basic/whoami — 200/401 probe,
refreshes csrftoken cookie

span.p: Idle

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Authenticated

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 10px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ResetPending

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Private_passwordresetcode row
6 digits from secrets.choice, expires_at = now + 1h
code emailed on a background thread

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Deactivated

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
switch_active / switch_paid wrap the flip in
transaction.atomic + select_for_update and copy every
OutstandingToken of the user into BlacklistedToken

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
is_active=False — authenticate() returns None.
Login answers 400 unless the password is also correct,
in which case 403 "已被停用".

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: TokensRevoked

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Deleted

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Privilege escalation is closed by construction:
is_staff / is_superuser / is_active and password are
stripped from every nested serializer path.
The only writer is PrivateViewSet.adjust-account (IsAdminUser).

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
apps/private/signals.py holds a PROTECTED_EMAILS allow-list
(values withheld here). pre_save raises PermissionError on any
is_staff / is_superuser / is_active change and pre_delete blocks
deletion for those accounts — a hard floor under admin mistakes.
